H854.h: אֵת, prep. with—prep. denoting proximity 1. Of companionship, together with 2. Of localities 3. אֵת פּ׳ denotes specially a. in one's possession or keeping b. in one's knowledge or memory 4. מֵאֵת from proximity with Note. אֵת expresses closer association than עִם: hence while מֵעִם sts. denotes hardly more than from the surroundings or belongings of, מֵאֵת expresses from close proximity to.
